items.title: Elvis Presley Rights Owners Sue Suno Over AI Voice Cloning: 'Elvis' Identity Was Stolen'
items.excerpt: A new lawsuit from Elvis Presley's rights owners claims Suno violated the singer's likeness rights by letting users clone his famous voice; Eminem's publisher Eight Mile Style filed a separate $41M suit the same day - new filings, not a continuation of the earlier Suno cases.

history_match.title: Elvis Presley Rightsholders Sue Anthropic for Training on 274 Songs Without Permission

items.title: Sampleson Wavefinder Uses Local AI To Search Audio Libraries By Sound
items.excerpt: Sampleson's new desktop app Wavefinder skips filenames and tags: a locally run AI model analyses your sample library and ranks sounds by similarity to a text description or a reference recording, with no uploads or subscription.

items.title: Logic Pro 13.0 now available with AI music tools and iPad control
items.excerpt: Apple has publicly released Logic Pro 13.0 with its Intelligent Assistant AI, a unified browser, an improved Stem Splitter and iPad Sidecar control; Creator Studio subscribers get the most features. (Off-list: public-release follow-up to the 10-28 beta; on-list outlets had no release item.)

items.title: Heritage Audio's i73 Pro gains NAM A2 support
items.excerpt: A firmware update lets Heritage Audio's i73 Pro interfaces run Neural Amp Modeler (NAM) A2 machine-learning amp captures directly on their internal DSP, bringing neural amp models into hardware.

history_match.title: Zoom Neurig: a $300 touchscreen amp modeler with NAM capture support and AI stem separation

items.title: Dr. Dre Has Zero Issues With AI in Music, Says He's 'Extremely Excited' About It
items.excerpt: On Ice Cube's new podcast, Dr. Dre said he is 'extremely excited' about AI in music production while Cube pushed back - another top-tier producer publicly backing AI tools.

items.title: The Edge asked AI to come up with a U2 song: 'They couldn't'
items.excerpt: The Edge says he tested AI music programs to see if they could write a U2 song and they couldn't - though they handle strictly codified genres like country - arguing U2's songwriting is 'never a formula'.

items.title: Grimes Joins AI-Generated Sci-Fi Film Gods Don't Give Gifts
items.excerpt: Grimes joins the cast of Gods Don't Give Gifts, an AI-generated animated sci-fi film from Zack London (Gossip Goblin) that pairs AI imagery with human voice performances, opening in US theaters December 4.

items.title: [주간AI노트] AI가 부른 노래가 차트 2위까지…"악기인가 가수인가"
items.excerpt: 생성형 AI 음악 앱으로 만든 머무르(MEOMURU)의 '꿈꾸던 어른이 되었나요?'가 멜론 TOP 100에서 최고 2위, 6일 기준 3위로 롱런하며 AI 보컬을 악기로 볼지 가수로 볼지 논쟁을 불렀다. (Off-list: on-list Korean outlets had no item.)

items.title: AI meme era hits K-pop — and even tycoons are dancing to 'Neon'
items.excerpt: A2O Lite's 'Neon' choreography went viral through AI-generated meme videos putting celebrities and tycoons in the dance - a promotion win that also brings new likeness/legal liability for K-pop labels. (Off-list.)

items.title: 인공지능이 작곡, 로봇이 춤…저작권은 누구 것?

items.title: AI 음악산업 성장 방안 찾는다… 저작권협회 정책 간담회
items.excerpt: (사)AI음악저작권협회가 6일 정책 간담회를 열고 AI 작곡·편곡, 음성 합성, 자동 마스터링이 음악 생산·유통 구조에 미치는 영향을 논의하며 AI 음악기술 전문가 6명을 정회원으로 위촉했다. (Off-list; page shows date only, time from Google News.)

items.title: ProCraft: Instruction-Driven Music Production from Free-Form Text
items.excerpt: ProCraft is a 0.5B-parameter codec language model that edits 30-second music excerpts end-to-end from free-form instructions, including compound requests - seven operations across eight instruments, from track removal to accompaniment generation.

items.title: Latent Terrain: Adapting Neural Audio Autoencoders as Design Materials in NIME
items.excerpt: Latent Terrain is a Max/MSP tool package that turns neural audio autoencoders' latent spaces into navigable, corpus-based sound spaces for new musical instruments - treating neural synthesis as a design material.

history_match.title: Smorph: playable diffusion-based sound morphing for musical sound design

items.title: FUSEMOS: Perceptual Evaluation of Text-to-Music Generation with Dual-Encoder Fusion and Ranking-Aware Composite Loss
items.excerpt: FUSEMOS fuses CLAP with the MERT music model to predict human ratings of text-to-music output, capturing timbre and expressiveness that CLAP-only evaluators miss.
